title: Quantifying Social Biases in NLP: A Generalization and Empirical Comparison of Extrinsic Fairness Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance differences (via generalized fairness metrics like PCM, BCM, MCM) in sentiment analysis and NER models using synthetic templates filled with explicit gender identity terms and gender-associated names.
Evaluating model performance disparities in downstream NLP tasks using synthetic templates populated with explicit sexual orientation identity terms.
Assessing model bias by measuring classification performance differences on synthetic text templates containing terms associated with various religious identities.
Measuring fairness metrics (such as differences in false positive/negative rates) using synthetic templates with explicit racial and ethnic identity terms.
Evaluating sentiment analysis and NER model performance parity across different age groups using hand-crafted templates with age-related identity terms.
Assessing algorithmic fairness by comparing model performance on synthetic text templates containing explicit disability-related identity terms.
Evaluating performance differences, particularly in named entity recognition (NER), across countries categorized by GDP using synthetic templates with country and nationality terms.
